four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: partial -- divisive normalisation / gain control of heterogeneous afferents before value integration (Carandini & Heeger 2012; Louie, Khaw & Glimcher 2013), faithful in kind. Two recorded divergences: (a) equal cross-candidate SD is A normalisation, not obviously THE one (carried from 1012a); (b) canonical DN normalises by the CONCURRENT pool, which is the ORACLE arm here; REE's running EMA is closer to slow adaptation because score_trajectory scores one candidate at a time. The run measures the cost of that divergence: R_ON < R_ORACLE in 8/8 cells. Not load-bearing (ON still clears the bar); no lit-pull owed.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: present, with a SCOPE bound -- operator engaged, clamp_config_landed and residue_protocol_landed 1.0 in all cells, n_content_channels 3 in all 8 cells. CAUTION: this gate is own-scale-relative (live by EMA AND sd_c(t) >= 0.1 * s_hat_c, no cross-channel term; driver L706-708), so it is satisfied by any non-dead channel -- including in every fed OFF-scored cell where R_OFF = 0.000 -- and is NOT a restoration of 571c's relative-SHARE n_live_channels gate (which could and did fail). The design's own red-team F6 called it 'a formality'. It certifies only that 3 channels are non-dead; the discrimination is carried by R_ON vs R_OFF. benefit_weighted and goal_weighted were never entered (0 content ticks; z_goal_stream ticks_active 0 of 53837 despite z_goal_enabled true), so the operator is validated as a 3-channel instance.
